prompt: Which sentence correctly separates Copilot’s two agent surfaces?
explanation: The exam loves this split: same idea, different venue. Agent Mode = IDE + your checkout; cloud agent = GitHub workspace + a pull request for review. Where the work happens is the differentiator.

options.text: Agent Mode works in your IDE on your local checkout; the cloud agent works on GitHub and opens a pull request
Agent Mode runs on GitHub servers; the cloud agent runs on your laptop
Both run on your laptop with identical capabilities
Both run on GitHub and always open pull requests
